title: Zesty Middle Eastern Duck Tabbouleh
description: A citrusy and creamy Middle Eastern dish featuring duck confit leg and bonito shave, served in a bamboo tray.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine the shredded duck confit leg, shaved bonito flakes, bulgur wheat, chopped parsley, and chopped mint.
In a small bowl, whisk together the lemon juice, olive oil, minced garlic, salt, and black pepper.
Pour the dressing over the duck mixture and toss to combine.
Spoon the tabbouleh onto a bamboo tray and garnish with additional parsley and mint if desired.
Cover the tray with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
Just before serving, give the tabbouleh a good stir and adjust the seasoning if necessary.
Serve the Zesty Middle Eastern Duck Tabbouleh chilled, straight from the bamboo tray.
